method.scope: Only current selected ValueDifference RAF42/52/62 parameter tensors; old CNN summary reused without checkpoint read.
method.summary: 64 latent channels, unweighted mean/sample SD/min/q10/median/q90/max; quantiles use linear interpolation.
method.frequency_domain: Observed-event index inside one segment, not physical elapsed time. Short-history values are finite-boundary coefficient-polynomial evaluations.
method.selection: Existing first strict finite minimum of fullValidation raw RMSE, unchanged; no outcome-based threshold or model selection.
limitations: Gain is a latent linear-filter coefficient property, not raw quantity error or an activation-weighted effect.
Q/K, projections, attention, memory and head are not included in this scalar response.
DC=1 preserves a constant projected V segment, not necessarily a constant raw quantity or the final prediction.
No causal attribution or next-training admission criterion is derived.
Channels are unweighted and latent coordinate axes are not aligned between independently trained models/seeds.

comparison_limits.different_structure: Old CNN independent 3-tap residual h=[1+k0,k1,k2], partial tap sums at short boundaries; current difference requires available pairs and is identity with one observation.
comparison_limits.hash_domains: Checkpoint raw bytes, serialization-independent named-state tensor SHA, and standalone coefficient raw bytes are distinct domains. Current kernel shape2x64 vs old3x64; no equality or channel alignment is implied.
comparison_limits.native_training_runtime: Current5090/cuDNN92000; storedCNN5080/cuDNN91900. Local tensor reading does not recreate either Runtime.

next_evidence_needed: Separate branch-mechanism and activation/paired-error diagnostic; this appendix alone cannot select a new training candidate.
